questions.question_text: Will at least three OECD member states enact nationally enforceable regulation requiring consumer devices sold after a published effective date to include hardware-backed decentralized identity (DID) or secure-element key storage for personal credentials, with enforcement beginning on or before 2035-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if national legal gazettes or regulator rulebooks in >=3 OECD members publish enforceable on-device hardware-backed DID or secure-element credential mandates with effective date <=2035-12-31. FALSE if fewer than three. VOID if mandates exist only as voluntary industry guidelines without statutory or regulator-enforceable penalties.

questions.question_text: Will at least one messaging service with end-to-end encryption enabled by default for all one-to-one and group chats report at least one billion daily active users worldwide on or before 2032-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if operator-published metrics or two independent third-party estimates corroborate >=1e9 DAU on a messaging service with E2EE default for all standard chat modes through 2032-12-31. FALSE if no service meets both conditions. VOID if DAU definitions differ materially without reconciliation or operator stops publishing comparable metrics.

questions.question_text: Will at least five OECD economies each report that at least 50 percent of households with internet access hold at least one active self-custody digital asset wallet (user-controlled private keys not solely custodied by a regulated exchange), according to official survey or regulator statistics, on or before 2038-12-31 UTC?
questions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if national statistical offices, central banks, or financial regulators in >=5 OECD members publish household surveys showing >=50% of internet-connected households with >=1 active self-custody wallet through 2038-12-31. FALSE if fewer than five meet threshold. VOID if wallet definitions exclude hardware wallets or conflate exchange accounts without key-export rights.
